images.caption:
Bedroom
This room is now Andrew Johnson Jr.'s Room. At the time it was Martha Johnson Patterson's bedroom, and the room in which she died. The family added the bay windows to the room, which were removed during the restoration of the house to Johnson's time period.
Keywords: anjo

images.caption: This is how the Andrew Johnson Homestead appeared in 1901, after the death of his daughter, Martha Johnson Patterson. She had added gables and porches during the Victorian Era, because she thought that would make it look more like a presidential shrine.

images.filename: The Andrew Johnson National Cemetery participates in Wreaths Across America each year to "Remember, Honor, and Teach." Local JR (32055daf-1dd8-b71b-0ba3-93e6d8aa6691).jpg
images.caption:
The Andrew Johnson National Cemetery participates in Wreaths Across America each year to "Remember, Honor, and Teach." Local JR ROTC students work with our veterans to place a wreath on each of the 1800 graves in the cemetery. The event culminates with a moving program and the placement of ceremonial wreaths for each branch of the service, plus MIA/POW.
Keywords: nps centennial
